direction: Hardwood clubhouse: walnut/sand/copper, Lora/DM Sans. Keep room/locker/bench/archive identity but open a substantial home composition by default. No doors that conceal almost all league material; allow secondary locker detail and retained comparison. Full normal document flow.

Rival halves: charcoal/amber/blue, Oswald. Preserve opposing-team axis/seam and paired reading. Make a complete matchup-led league homepage with substantive complementary material visible beyond the pairing; do not require a side/tab to reveal most of the home.

Route blueprint: cobalt/pale blue/ink/orange, Space Mono/DM Sans. Keep open evidence branches and coexisting context; meaningful preview content along branches must already form a complete homepage, not a tiny node menu. No fixed/internal readers.

Working exchange: green-black/lime/mint, IBM/DM Sans. Preserve working quote/package character as one useful part of a substantial market/league homepage. Current home cannot simply be a trade utility. Visible context/news/market/league material should stand independently of tray edits.

Query commons: lilac/teal/coral, Space Grotesk/DM Sans. Keep search-first identity and inline answers, but before any search show a fully composed useful league commons with substantive material, not only search suggestions. Query enhances visible home.

League constellation: obsidian/silver/cyan, Orbitron/DM Sans. Preserve connected franchise territories, relationship and third comparison. Full visible league homepage uses spatial identity across openly readable material, no fixed scene/roster windows or tiny selector-led page.

Varsity folio: navy/gold/white, Graduate/DM Sans. Preserve unequal leaves, binding/spines and publication character. A whole useful folio homepage must be openly present in page flow, not one selected fold hiding most home content. Different spread geometry stays.

Parallel dispatch: citron/ink/steel/white, Archivo Black/DM Sans. Preserve distinct parallel topics and related-passage links. Full substantive channels must flow in the actual document with no internal scroll panes; deliberate phone transformation must expose a home, not require channel selection for all content.

Sky calendar: sky/ink/rust, DM Sans. Preserve source-period calendar/agenda identity. Expand into a complete dated league homepage with actual useful material visible, not just a sparse planner requiring event clicks. Keep supplied dates distinct, no invented games/schedules.

Black-line ledger: black/white/signal red, IBM/Archivo. Preserve dense flat working league sheet, column logic and inline records. Make a substantial complete league homepage whose immediate content is usable without sheet/field selection hiding most of it. Phone records readable and open.

Evidence lab: peach/lavender/indigo/teal, Space Grotesk/DM Sans. Preserve identity-by-measure comparisons and source clarity. Expand from a two-player tool into a full league evidence homepage with substantive useful context/material already visible; no bounded matrix internal readers supplying whole home.

Franchise yearbook: navy/ivory/gold, Bebas/DM Sans. Preserve identity-led directory, huge club typography, portraits and in-flow dossier. Curate into a complete useful league homepage, not a very long directory alone. Search can enhance, not replace a visibly full home. Avoid empty portrait intervals.

Arcade matchbook: plum/turquoise/pink/white, short Press Start accent/DM Sans. Preserve branching intent/ancestry and useful current root. Open branches should contain substantive readable home information by default; do not present only action sentences that lead to tiny feature pages. Full visible home, not menu app.
